description: This file implements various linear algebra algorithms related to low-rank matrices, including functions for approximating bases, low-rank SVD, and PCA, specifically optimized for low-rank matrix computations within the PyTorch library.

methods.name: Tensor get_approximate_basis( A: Tensor, q: int, niter: int | None = 2, M: Tensor | None = None, )
methods.description: Computes an approximate basis (Q) with orthonormal columns that approximates the input matrix A (or A-M if M is provided), based on Halko et al.'s randomized algorithm, using iterative QR decompositions.

methods.name: tuple[Tensor,Tensor,Tensor] svd_lowrank( A: Tensor, q: int | None = 6, niter: int | None = 2, M: Tensor | None = None, )
methods.description: Computes a low-rank singular value decomposition (U, S, V) of matrix A (or A - M if M is provided) using randomized projections, suitable for large low-rank matrices.

methods.name: tuple[Tensor,Tensor,Tensor] _svd_lowrank( A: Tensor, q: int | None = 6, niter: int | None = 2, M: Tensor | None = None, )
methods.description: Internal implementation of the low-rank SVD algorithm based on Halko et al.'s method, used by svd_lowrank.

methods.name: tuple[Tensor,Tensor,Tensor] pca_lowrank( A: Tensor, q: int | None = None, center: bool = True, niter: int = 2, )
methods.description: Performs low-rank PCA on matrix A, returning matrices U, S, V that approximate the full SVD, with optional centering and handling of sparse matrices.
